sed et omnes qui cognoverunt veritatem,: but also all they that have known the truth
propter veritatem que permanet in vobis: for the sake of the truth which dwelleth in us
et a Christo Iesu Filio Patris: and from Christ Jesus the Son of the Father
IESU CHRISTO FILIO PATRIS: Jesus Christ the Son of the Father
quoniam inveni de filiis tuis: that I found of thy children
mandatum accepimus a Patre. Et nunc rogo: we have received a commandment from the Father
Et hec est caritas ut ambulemus: And this is charity, that we walk
Hoc enim mandatum est ut quemadmodum aud: For this is the commandment, that, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in the same
venientem in carne, hic est seductor et: is come in the flesh: this is a seducer and an antichrist
Videte vosmetipsos ne perdatis que opera: Look to yourselves, that you lose not the things which you have wrought
that you may receive a full reward
in doctrina Christi, Deum non habent Qui: in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God
the same hath both the Father and the Son
Si quis venit ad vos et hanc doctrinam n: If any man come to you, and bring not this doctrine
nolite recipere eum in domum nec 'ave' e: receive him not into the house nor say to him, God speed you
NEC AVE EI DIXERITIS: nor say to him, God speed you
Qui enim dicit illi 'ave' communicat ope: For he that saith unto him, God speed you, communicateth with his wicked works
Plura habens vobis scribere,: Having more things to write unto you
nolui per cartam et atramentum,: I would not by paper and ink
spero enim me futurum apud vos: for I hope that I shall be with you
that your joy may be full
The children of thy sister Elect salute thee.
